candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `pot += msg.value;` so the pot is never increased on play.
Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot += 1;` so the pot grows by 1 instead of the ticket amount.
Move `pot += msg.value;` to inside the `if (random == 0)` block so the pot only increases on a winning play before being reset to 0.
Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot = msg.value;` so the pot is overwritten instead of accumulated.
Delete the statement `pot += msg.value;` so the pot never accumulates ticket payments.
Delete the statement `pot = 0;` so the pot is not reset after a win.
Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot += TICKET_AMOUNT;`... actually with `pot = msg.value;` so the pot is overwritten instead of accumulated.
Replace `pot = 0;` with `pot = FEE_AMOUNT;` so the pot retains a nonzero value after a win.
